integrity: The proof establishes the infinite family. Independent finite-state verification is supporting evidence only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to synchronous self-exclusive characteristic-two linear updates after exactly one cube vertex is removed. No statement about multiple vertex faults, stochastic updates, or odd-characteristic fields is established. Full-history priority is not certified.
title: A parity-fractured Jordan law for vertex-deleted hypercube XOR dynamics
